validation: All21 fixed validation histories, common full-boundary KL, equal task means at available original offsets; never hidden tests
checkpoint_selection: Minimum validation KL among completed trained checkpoints, ties earlier step. At least one full update and all21 validation cases required. No development outcome selects this checkpoint.
interruption: Save mapper state after every full update, before checking time/stop; immutable validated checkpoints nominated. No optimizer-resume claim.
time_rule: Training stops at128updates or90minutes; reserve worker time for validating a latest full update if none validated. No convergence required or claimed.
initial_dev: Measure affine baseline alongside trained C on all40 same development tasks where practical; never use these scores for checkpoint selection.
cache_reconstruction: Full saved source prefix in512-token chunks for mapper input, identical to training runtime. No cropping or source resampling. Native D rebuilt with its original chunked schedule and same RNG; preserve any token drift and report matched D separately.
confirmation: Reserved200 and second-seed40 untouched; development exploratory only.
